description: Add a section to a space (omit `section`; pass kind: task, event or note) or change one (name it by id or name; only the fields you pass change). Every kind takes filters (conditions or filter_groups). Task sections also take sort (fields or prop:<key>), group_by or group_by_property, kanban, show_all_kanban_columns, column_order, group_sort_ascending and hide_completed; note sections take note_sort. Validated and written like set_space; dry_run:true writes nothing.

column_order.description:
Kanban column order by group value; an empty array clears it (task
sections).

condition_match.description: How `conditions` combine: all, any or none.

conditions.description:
Filter conditions `{type, operator, value}` as the app writes them;
together they replace the filter with one group. Every kind.

dry_run.description: Validate and report the space as it would be written, writing nothing.

filter_groups.description:
Every filter group, replacing the filter: an array of
`{conditions: [...], matchMode: all|any|none}`. Every kind.

group_by.description:
Group by a built-in axis: none, fileName, filePath, fullFilePath,
dueDate, priority, status, tags, contexts, projects, createdDate,
scheduledDate, startDate, completionDate, cancelledDate, happensDate,
happensTime or blocked. Replaces a property grouping (task sections).

group_by_property.description:
Group by a custom property (its key); an empty string stops grouping
by one (task sections).

groups_match.description: How the filter groups combine: all, any or none.

hide_completed.description: Add the app's "not done or cancelled" filter group (task sections).

kanban.description: Show the groups as Kanban columns (task sections).

kind.description: task, event or note. Only when adding.

manual_task_order.description:
Drag order for a manual sort: task ids first to last; an empty array
clears it (task sections).

name.description: Section name; an empty string clears it back to the default label.

note_sort.description:
Note sections: name, modified or created, optionally `:asc` or
`:desc` (default newest first).

section.description:
The section to change (id or name). Omit to add a section at the end,
which then needs `kind`.

show_all_kanban_columns.description:
Show a column for every possible group value, empty ones included
(task sections).

sort.description: Sort levels in order, replacing the sort (task sections).

field.description:
A sort field (priority, dueDate, scheduledDate, startDate,
completedDate, cancelledDate, alphabetical, dateCreated, dateModified,
filePath, fileName, fullFilePath, lineNumber, happensDate,
happensTime, status, tags, projects, contexts, dependencyStatus,
manual) or `prop:<key>` for a custom property.

name: set_section
